title: polyarrhena reflexa subsp. brachyphylla
intro: Polyarrhena reflexa subsp. brachyphylla, commonly known as the Queensland kauri pine, is a plant species endemic to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polyarrhena reflexa subsp. brachyphylla include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
